name: HyperPower
description: Shakes the entire desktop while you type, like Hyper's HyperPower plugin. Every key press jitters the window gaps and runs the crunch pack: random corner rounding, a neon border strobe, and thicker borders. The original look comes back when you stop typing.

barWidget.description: Shake the whole desktop while you type. Click to toggle.

schema.label: Crunch pack
schema.description: Random corner rounding, neon border strobe, and thicker borders on every key press.
